description: This is a shell script used to build and manage Docker images, specifically related to the 'cuttlefish' project. It initializes the environment, processes command-line arguments for output destination, determines the script location, retrieves the current Git commit hash, constructs a Docker image name, sets up a cleanup trap to remove the Docker image upon script exit, builds the Docker image, and saves it to a specified output.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: remove_image
methods.description: Removes the Docker image with the specified name.
